facts.fact: Morocco World News says the CNDP's DATA-TIKA programme operates in line with Law No. 09-08 on personal data, adopted in 2009 by Dahir No. 1-09-15 of 18 February 2009.
The CNDP, created by Law 09-08, is acting under its president Omar Seghrouchni, who signed a partnership agreement with NIIAT on 21 October 2026.

The CNDP's DATA-TIKA programme, launched 9 July 2020, runs partnerships and training, including a six-month pilot to train at least 20,000 young people in Casablanca-Settat; no decision under the law is reported.
